newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 287,200 metric tons (MT) were 4 percent lower than the previous week and one-third below the 4-week average. Major increases reported for Japan (140,400 MT), Mexico (78,100 MT), Italy (26,200 MT), and Jamaica (19,000 MT) were partially offset by decreases for unknown destinations (62,300 MT).

Exports of 374,400 MT were up 11 percent from the week earlier and 5 percent from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were the Philippines (64,000 MT), Japan (60,500 MT), Israel (48,300 MT), Pakistan (31,500 MT), and South Korea (31,400 MT).
